text: International MBA program aims to cultivate business elites and future leaders with international perspectives, innovative thoughts and local insights through developing students’ systematic theoretical knowledge and comprehensive managerial skills. The program adopt fully English teaching model and is specifically designed for those oversea business persons who plan to explore their career in Chinese business area. This program will stick to combine global perspective with Chinese featured courses and integrate eastern business theory with western’s theory. The School of Economics and Business Administration(SEBA) will try its best to construct a firs-class solely English-teaching International MBA program with China economic background. SEBA will actively innovate in all aspects to develop the program, involving the aspect of faculty, teaching model, teaching management, students activity and career development. ◆This program will invite those famous foreign experts and scholars as program teachers of the basic course and theory course, while SEBA faculty will undertake those feature courses and major courses. ◆The program will adopt advanced interactive teaching model and case study, mainly emphasizing students’ participation. Students will master theory knowledge through the case study and real practice.
